title: review: G5 fix round 1: per-session Jev state file writes take the shared state lock, _target_mtime stats the real path and only the logged target is redacted; the seven acceptance tests at f9747a8 stay green (review T-0338)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain d7ce217 and f9747a8 (T-0273, sampled Jev gate plus its seven acceptance tests) in git log; never drop or amend them. The two test findings of review T-0338 are already answered by f9747a8: confirm the seven named tests exist and pass, do not rewrite them.
Remaining findings of review T-0338 on T-0273:
1. (med) orchestrator/jev_gate.py _record_call does a read-modify-write on .orchestrator/state/runs/jev/session-{id}.json with no lock, while jev.py guards jev_state.json with STATE_LOCK_FILE. PreToolUse hooks fire concurrently for parallel tool calls, so repeat counts can be lost and a partial write makes json.loads fail and silently reset the session state to {}. Guard the read-modify-write with the same lock helper jev.py uses (reuse it, do not add a second locking scheme), write atomically (temp file plus os.replace), and treat an unparseable file as corrupt: log one stderr warning and start from {} instead of silently resetting.
2. (low) _target returns jev.redact(path) and _target_mtime then calls os.stat on that redacted string, so any path matching a redaction pattern (32+ character alnum runs, content-hashed cache dirs) gets mtime None forever and repeat clearing never fires for it. Keep the real path for os.stat and hashing; redact only the value that is written to gate rows or logs.
Tests to add in tests/test_jev_gate.py: test_record_call_serialises_concurrent_writes (two threads or interleaved calls both land, count is exact), test_corrupt_session_file_warns_and_recovers, test_target_mtime_uses_unredacted_path (a path whose basename is a 40-char hex string gets a real mtime while the logged target is redacted).
Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id in the message; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f9747a8 and d7ce217 below your commit
orchestrator/jev_gate.py session-file writes go through the jev.py lock helper and os.replace; os.stat is never called on a redacted string (grep)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: Session state path is built from an unvalidated session_id (f"session-{session_id}.json"). No sanitization/allowlist on the identifier before it reaches a filesystem path used in a mkstemp+os.replace write. Low exploitability today since session_id is CLI-generated, but worth a narrow validation (e.g. reject/hash anything not matching a UUID-ish pattern) per the path-injection checklist item.
block_repeats denial message says 'identical read already made this session' but block_repeats fires for any repeated tool call, not just reads (Bash/Edit/Write included). Misleading stderr message.
